conclusion.sharding: CONFIRMED. 256 experts split 86/85/85 across EP ranks 0/1/2 on a live engine.
conclusion.speed: REGRESSION. EP is ~2.5x slower per stream than the b12x baseline.
conclusion.attribution: The regression is the MoE KERNEL, not node count. EP=2 on the same two nodes as the baseline yields 21-22 tok/s, statistically identical to EP=3's 19-20. Adding the third node costs only ~10% (21 -> 19).
conclusion.root_cause: flashinfer_b12x refuses expert parallelism by design: b12x_mxfp4_moe.py:597-603 requires use_ep == False and ep_size <= 1. Enabling EP forces a fallback to a generic kernel.
conclusion.trade: 2.30x KV cache capacity for 2.5x per-stream speed.

rdma_link_bandwidth_gbits.caveat: Single-QP default. ~55% of 200 Gb/s line rate. NOT re-tested with -q 4/8, so this may be a test-harness ceiling rather than a hardware one.
